name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Bilateral NDA standard terms allowing two parties to exchange confidential information under mutual protection obligations.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Companion cover page for the Mutual NDA that captures deal-specific terms such as purpose, effective date, and term of confidentiality.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling or buying cloud-hosted software and SaaS products, covering access, support, data, payment, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Companion SLA to the Cloud Service Agreement defining uptime targets, response times, and service credit remedies.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: SOW-based agreement governing the delivery of professional services and deliverables, including IP assignment and payment terms.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR/privacy-focused agreement governing how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement governing early access to a product for select customers who provide feedback during a design partnership.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premises or installed software, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, and warranties.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership or referral relationship, including trademark licensing and revenue-sharing obligations.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-required agreement governing a business associate's use and protection of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term trial or evaluation agreement letting a customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Supplemental terms governing the use of AI or machine learning features layered onto an underlying agreement, covering inputs, outputs, and model training.
